QuestInfo.name: Know Your Surroundings
QuestInfo.0: #p3001101# needs your help. Go talk to him.
QuestInfo.1:
#p3001101# asks you to eliminate the following:

#b100#k #o2400107# monsters at the #m401040700# .
#b100#k #o2400108# monsters at the #m401040200#.
#b100#k #o2400109# monsters at the #m401040100#.

Report back to #p3001100# once you're done.
QuestInfo.2: You eliminated the Specters per #p3001101#'s request. Public order can now be maintained.

0.0: Why don't you ever visit me anymore? Am I only going to get to see your pretty face when creeps like that guy Velderoth show up?\r\n#L0##bWatch your mouth about Velderoth... He has to have a reason.#l\n#k
0.1: I don't give a single poop about his reasons! He's standing on the wrong side of the line. Now, I'll forgive your weak-hearted reaction to that traitor, since you and I are so close, but I need you to do a little clean-up work around here.\r\n#L0##bThere's nothing between us! Ugh, why does every man think we're dating?!#l\n#k
0.2: Hahaha, that tactic never works on me, missy. Now are you going to take the job, or not?

yes.0: I've got a laundry-list of jerks I want to see smashed all over the ground out there. So, let's make it fun! You take down #b100 #o2400107#, #o2400108#, and #o2400109##k troops, and I'll come up and laugh at every single one of them. Go tell #b#p3001100##k when you're done.

1.0: I'm very busy right now. What do you want?

yes.0: I was wondering why the Specters were so quiet. I see you did what you do best, causing havoc. My headache actually seems to be calming down...

default.0: I have a headache the size of a small planet floating around behind my eyes. Tell me what you want and leave me alone.

npc.0: #p3001100# is right next to you, haha!
